seen.body: Owner 2026-10-10 on 4.1.0: 'items should be first and then what we do with it'. qew attach|detach|extract become qew item attach|detach|extract ITEM ... (group style like qew pr and qew draft). Strict rename of commands released minutes earlier, no alias (no consumer yet).
seen.title: Attachment commands live under qew item: item first, then the action
